run_dinov2_training: run DINOv2 training by submitting jobs via submitit with a config file and training arguments
run_Trainer_call: run the Trainer class to set up job environment args and execute DINOv2 training main
run_Trainer_checkpoint: run the Trainer checkpoint method to requeue a training job using submitit DelayedSubmission
run_Trainer_setup_args: run the Trainer _setup_args method to resolve job ID placeholders and log process group info
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to parse training args, set up logging, and submit DINOv2 training jobs
